## Required Task Fields

```yaml
lane: validation_tooling
intelligence_level: frontier
reason: "Fixture isolates read-set expansion."
durable_source_of_truth: "GitHub issue #1004"
objective: "Reject an added context item."
plan:
  - compare read sets
checklist:
  - expansion fails
acceptance_sheet:
  - exact expansion code is reported
allowed_paths:
  - scripts/asgk.py
expected_output:
  - failed task packet check
non_goals:
  - no implementation
stop_conditions:
  - expansion is accepted
rollback_expectations:
  - remove fixture
context_read_set:
  - AGENTS.md
project_specific_validation:
  - python3 scripts/asgk.py task-packet-check
```
